notes.subject: לשלמה
notes.rationale: Sɛbɛnni-yɛlɛma 'Sulumana (Shelomoh) fɛ' — ladamɛ-yɔrɔ misali: tɔgɔ min bɛ fɔ ka kɛ sɛbɛnni-jira ye (A Sulumana ta) walima lasabati ye 'fɛ' (Sulumana kama); an ta 'fɛ' (lasabati-cogo min bɔ Koinɛ Grek la).

notes.subject: Elohim
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ Elohim wele ni ka sɔn o ma k'a ɲini — tigi-sira min bɛ Tɔgɔ nɔ na.

notes.subject: di
notes.rationale: Kari-daɲɛ 'di' ye — kuma min bɛ tigi wele k'a ɲini ni fɛn ye; sɔngɔ-dantigɛ ye.

notes.subject: Shelomoh / shalom
notes.rationale: Tɔgɔ Shelomoh (v1) ni shalom (v3, v7) bɛ bɔ kun-dilen kan kelen ye — sɛbɛn-niɔgɔya min bɔ Bamanankan na.

translation: Sulumana (Shelomoh) fɛ, Elohim, i ka sariyaw di masakɛ ma, ani i ka tiɲɛ-ɲumanw di masakɛ denkɛ ma.
